tooltip.isekai_mahou.phylactery.hint1: Kill with the Bone Scythe, or with the Phylactery in your off hand.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.phylactery.hint2: Offer the souls at the Ossuary Altar at midnight.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.phylactery.hint3: Right click while holding it (sneak if it is in the off hand): shows what the next rite requires.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.bone_scythe.1: Kills with the scythe store the soul in your Phylactery.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.bone_scythe.3: Right click: Reap (a spinning slash that hits nearby enemies).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ossuary_altar.1: Heart of the Necromancer's Ossuary Rite.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ossuary_altar.2: Below: a ring of 8 Bone Blocks around the altar's foot.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ossuary_altar.3: Corners (2 blocks diagonally): skulls, lit candles or soul lights.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.ossuary_altar.4: At midnight, use the Phylactery on it.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.altar_busy: The Ossuary Altar is already performing a rite.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.max_rank: You have completed every Ossuary Rite. The dead bow before you.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.structure_ok: Altar complete: bone ring and corners ready
message.isekai_mahou.necro.missing_ring: %s Bone Blocks missing from the ring (around the altar's foot, 1 block below)
message.isekai_mahou.necro.missing_corne: %s corners missing (2 blocks diagonally from the altar)
message.isekai_mahou.necro.corner_hint: Corners accept a skull or head, a lit candle, a soul torch, lantern or campfire, on the ground or 1 block up. Missing spots are marked with particles.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.skulls: True skulls (skeleton or wither) on the corners: %s/%s
message.isekai_mahou.necro.midnight_now: It is midnight: the veil between worlds is thin
message.isekai_mahou.necro.not_midnight: It is not midnight yet (about %s real minutes left)
message.isekai_mahou.necro.no_moon: There is no midnight here: perform the rite under the Overworld moon
message.isekai_mahou.necro.ready: Everything is ready! Offer the Phylactery to the altar.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.rite_subtitle: The souls answer the midnight call
message.isekai_mahou.necro.rite_begin: You offer the souls to the altar... the Ossuary Rite %s has begun.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.no_glyph: No new Necromancy glyph this time.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.servant_cap: Your undead servant limit grew by %s (total rite bonus: +%s).
message.isekai_mahou.necro.servant_gift_: Your %s gifted servants still standing already fill the rite's slots: no new servant rose.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.servant_gift: %s undead servant(s) rose to serve you.
message.isekai_mahou.necro.soul_lost: The soul fades away... (you have no Phylactery)
message.isekai_mahou.necro.phylactery_fu: The Phylactery cannot hold more %s souls
message.isekai_mahou.necro.next_rite_sku: ...and %s true skull(s) on the altar corners
command.isekai_mahou.necro.no_phylactery: Hold a Phylactery in your hand.
